title: [Feature Request] Ability to go offline
observation: [Feature Request] Ability to go offline I would like to request an ability to disconnect client without quitting completely, like all other good messengers have. By right-clicking on taskbar icon, user should be able to switch between online and offline status. While offline, client shouldn't be able to send/receive any network requests and generally behave like there's no Internet connection at all. Without this feature, the only way to disconnect the client is to terminate it, which is extremely annoying.

title: Always On Top Window in Tiling Window Managers
observation: Always On Top Window in Tiling Window Managers I'm using the i3 window manager and have some problems with the always on top window. The window manager does not detect it as a "floating" window, hence the window will be displayed as a tile. As the main window and the always on top window don't have any different X11 window properties, I can't configure i3 to automatically set the always on top window to floating mode, without also setting the main window into floating mode. Many tiling window managers use [X11 window manager hints](https://specifications.freedesktop.org/wm-spec/wm-spec-1.3.html) to determine whether to display a window in tiling or floating mode. Skype for Linux has a similar functionality, so I checked which X11 window properties differ from the always on top window in Jitsi. In this case, Skype hints a maximum size to the window manager, which will cause i3 to classify
